title: The gunship takes its track once per pass, and leaving a seat restores the tank's lens
context: Owner playtest, 2026-09-15: in the gunship the camera still sometimes jumps to a totally new spot when launching weapon 3, the heavy; getting into the tank after the gunship puts it in third person at the wrong angle.
outcome: The platform's track pointed at gunshipLane(), which is the live breach while it stands. A 105 that killed the breach switched the lane to the ring or the lane end, and ride() rebuilt the platform's position and heading in one frame; the seat's yaw is relative to that frame, so the view cut. ride() now latches the lane end on the first tick of a pass and keeps it until the pass ends. Leaving a seat never restored the camera: the seat's zoom sets fov 60/zoom, so the tank's third-person view came back through the gunship's narrow lens. leavePilot now resets fov to the camera's 68 before re-seating third person, which also covers leaving a sentry.
alternatives: Ease the track toward the new lane: rejected, a slow swing of the whole seat mid-aim is still the camera moving on its own.
evidence: npm test (107 programs) and npm run check pass. No browser playtest: the memory guardrail was at WARN.
